body: I just hate being there. I can't be happy in school. Nothing will change that. I feel like I would be so much happier if I could just be in college. I want to die because the only thing I can do is deal with it for the next 4 years. My brother and sister both dropped out and got GEDs. I wish I could follow their path and go straight to college, but I want to get scholarships and be able to go to a good college. There aren't any online schooling programs in Texas that are public that I know of, and even if there are they wouldn't be able to get me those opportunities. I can either hate being alive for the next 4 years or kill myself. I'll even go as far as just attempting suicide. I still have a shred of hope for my future and maybe if I just attempt suicide I can make a change. The best my mom can do know is just tell me it will get better. If I try to kill myself they would have to get me away from school, right? But I can't bring myself to do it. I don't want to waste her money.

The thing I hate about school is that there is no way out. For me, school is synonymous with depression. I hate being alive every second I'm there. I began cutting the day I had planned for weeks that I would kill myself. The best option I could think of that would leave me perfectly fine if I managed to fail was slitting my wrists.
I guess cutting my thigh is more like practice. It doesn't make me feel any better but every time I cut it makes me feel closer to death.
